claim_text: Psyllium can alter the timing or absorption of some oral medicines; the appropriate separation interval is medicine- and product-specific, so users taking regular medication should check the exact product label or obtain pharmacist guidance rather than apply a universal interval.
health_goal_or_outcome: Reduce potential medication-absorption interactions when using psyllium.

population.health_status: People using regular medication and considering psyllium.
population.other_context: Medication type, formulation and product directions determine timing.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Oral psyllium husk powder, granules, capsules and other fiber preparations.
evidence_summary: FDA/official psyllium product labeling and warnings support checking directions; exact medicine-specific intervals require product monographs and pharmacist review.
limitations: No universal separation interval is established by this general claim.
Source must be matched to exact product classification and formulation.
Pharmacist review is needed for narrow-therapeutic-index or timing-sensitive medicines.
